data.one_liner: Flutter plugin to implement in-app subscriptions, purchases, and analytics.
data.what_it_does: The Qonversion Flutter plugin provides tools to handle in-app purchases, subscriptions, receipt validation, and cross-platform access control for iOS, Android, and macOS. It also includes out-of-the-box support for subscription analytics and A/B experiments.
use_when: You need to manage in-app purchases and subscriptions across iOS, Android, and macOS.
You want server-side receipt validation and cross-platform access management.
You need out-of-the-box subscription analytics or A/B experiments for paywalls.
avoid_when: You only need simple local payment processing without server-side validation or analytics.
You are building apps for platforms other than Android, iOS, and macOS.
strengths: Simplifies integration with Apple StoreKit and Google Billing.
Provides built-in subscription analytics, A/B testing, and webhooks.
Caches purchase data locally so the SDK functions smoothly with poor network connections.
weaknesses: Requires managing native configuration for iOS/macOS and Android.
Breaking changes can require updating mock implementations of abstract classes.
data.setup_notes: Follow the official quick start guide. Native dependencies are resolved via Swift Package Manager or CocoaPods for iOS/macOS.

alternatives.name: purchases_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative cross-platform in-app purchase and subscription management SDK (RevenueCat).
